message.content: Keysight Technologies announced its participation in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on Friday, September 11, 2026 [D6]. Keysight Technologies announced its participation in the 2026 Truist Technology Symposium on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 [D6]. Keysight Technologies collaborated with the Centre for Assuring Autonomy at the University of York to advance AI safety assurance for software-defined vehicles on September 3, 2026 [D7].
